messages.content:
Here is general information about metformin: Metformin is prescribed to help manage blood sugar in type 2 diabetes. Take it exactly as prescribed and follow your care team's blood sugar monitoring plan. Common side effects can include nausea, diarrhea, stomach discomfort. Important cautions: Tell your clinician about kidney, liver, heart, or heavy alcohol use risks. Seek urgent help for severe weakness, unusual sleepiness, deep or rapid breathing, severe vomiting, or feeling very cold. Source: MedlinePlus - Metformin.

Still needed: Dose or strength and when it was taken; Relevant conditions such as pregnancy, kidney disease, liver disease, ulcers, or blood thinner use

This is general information, not a diagnosis. Please contact your doctor or care team for personal medical advice.

Use medication only as directed on the label or by your prescriber. If you notice severe symptoms, an allergic reaction, or took more than directed, seek urgent help.
